name: slot_kind: Viking label with supplement + single PDF is other_file
label: This role requires a brief research supplement … Please upload your resume and brief research supplement — as a single PDF
quote: Everything else → "other_file" (no document word at all, an OTHER word, two kinds named, or combine wording).

name: slot_kind: resume + cover letter in one combined document is other_file
label: Resume and cover letter combined into one PDF
quote: Everything else → "other_file" (no document word at all, an OTHER word, two kinds named, or combine wording).

name: slot_kind: 'Resume or CV' names only the RESUME kind
label: Resume or CV
quote: The label names exactly one of RESUME / COVER / TRANSCRIPT, no OTHER word and no combine word → that kind ("resume", "cover_letter", "transcript").

name: slot_kind: lone Transcript
label: Transcript

name: slot_kind: Unofficial transcript (PDF)
label: Unofficial transcript (PDF)
quote: The label names exactly one of RESUME / COVER / TRANSCRIPT, no OTHER word and no combine word → that kind ("resume", "cover_letter", "transcript").

name: slot_kind: label with no document word
label: Additional information
quote: Everything else → "other_file" (no document word at all, an OTHER word, two kinds named, or combine wording).

name: slot_kind: Writing sample is an OTHER word

name: slot_kind: Motivation letter is a COVER word

name: file_slots: answers.json names an existing file for an other_file slot
quote: answers.json (a JSON object in the folder) has the slot's key and its value is the name of a file that exists directly in the folder → that name.

name: file_slots: answers.json value naming a nonexistent file is ignored
quote: A value that is not an existing file in the folder (missing, a sub-path, "..", an absolute path, or a plain text answer) is ignored.

quote: A value that is not an existing file in the folder (missing, a sub-path, "..", an absolute path, or a plain text answer) is ignored.

name: file_slots: resume and cover_letter kind slots match upper-case .PDF names; non-file fields excluded

fields.label: Why do you want this role?

quote: Each slot = {key, label, required (bool), kind = slot_kind(key, label), file = file name or null}.

name: file_slots: resume kind picks first .pdf in sorted name order
quote: kind "resume" → the first (sorted by name) file in the folder ending in .pdf (any case) whose name contains "resume" (any case); none → null.

name: file_slots: resume kind with no resume PDF present is null
quote: kind "resume" → the first (sorted by name) file in the folder ending in .pdf (any case) whose name contains "resume" (any case); none → null.

name: file_slots: transcript kind filled by Transcript.pdf
quote: kind "transcript" → "Transcript.pdf" when that file exists in the folder; else null.

name: missing_file_slots: required other_file slot missing, optional missing not reported
quote: Optional slots without a file are never reported.

name: missing_file_slots: standard resume file field is not an extra slot
quote: Only plan fields with type "file" whose key is not "resume" and not "cover_letter".

name: missing_file_slots: required slot satisfied via answers.json is not reported
quote: missing_file_slots(plan, folder) → the slots from file_slots that are required and have file null.

name: missing_file_slots: two required missing slots reported in plan order
quote: file_slots(plan, folder) → list of extra slots, in plan order

name: missing_file_slots: lowercase transcript.pdf does not satisfy a required transcript slot
quote: A required extra slot with no file stops the application BEFORE Submit and is handed to Joey (status needs-user, with the slot's label); it is never submitted without the file.

name: after_submit: confirmed page wins over errors
quote: confirmed (the confirmation page or a new thank-you text was seen) → status "submitted", fields [].

name: after_submit: security code page is unconfirmed even with a new message
quote: otherwise, code_page true (the page asks for an e-mailed security code) → "unconfirmed", fields [] (a message on the code step is not a form validation error).

name: after_submit: new validation error means failed
quote: Any new error → status "failed" (the form refused it, nothing was submitted), fields = the new errors' field names, each once, in order.

name: after_submit: same field with different message is not a new error
quote: otherwise, new errors = entries of after whose field does not appear as a field in before.

name: after_submit: multiple new errors deduplicated in order
quote: fields = the new errors' field names, each once, in order.

name: after_submit: nothing new and not confirmed is unconfirmed
quote: otherwise → "unconfirmed", fields [].

name: after_submit: mix of repeated and new error reports only the new field
quote: otherwise, new errors = entries of after whose field does not appear as a field in before.
